verses.1: And from there, Abraham went to the land of Negev. He settled between Binn-Kadesh and Shur. There, he lived in a place called Gerar.
verses.2: And Abraham said to his wife Sarah, “She is my only daughter.” Then he sent Abimelech, king of Gerar, and he took Sarah away with him.
verses.3: And God came to Abimelech in a dream that night. He said to him, “You will die because you took the woman she took from you.”
verses.4: And Abimelech did not come to her. He said, “Lord, even the righteous will be punished.”
verses.5: He didn’t say to me, “My sister, he is also one of them.” She also said, “Brother, he is indeed one of them.” With all my heart and with all my strength, I did this.
verses.6: And God said to him in a dream, “I also knew that you did this out of hatred in your heart. Therefore, I will not allow you to touch her.”
verses.7: And now, let the man who is a prophet sit down. He shall pray for you. May he save you. But if you do not return, then know that you will die, along with everyone else who follows you.
verses.8: And Abimelech went out in the morning, called all his servants, and told them all these things. The people were terrified by these words.
verses.9: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, “What have you done to us? What sin have I committed against you, that you brought upon me and my kingdom such a great sin? You have done things that should not be done.”
verses.10: And Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see that you did such a thing?”
verses.11: And Abraham said, “I said only that there is no fear of God in this place. Therefore, they killed me because of my wife’s words.”
verses.12: And indeed, my sister, the daughter of my father, is not my mother’s daughter. She became my wife.
verses.13: And when God took me away from my father’s house, he said to me, “This is your grace, that you may go before me to all the places where I will come. My brother said to me, ‘Go with me.’”
verses.14: And Abimelech took sheep, cattle, servants, and women, and gave them to Abraham. Then he returned to him with Sarah, his wife.
verses.15: And Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you, in your eyes. Return it to me in peace.”
verses.16: And Elsharra said, “Now, I have given you one thousand pieces of silver for your brother. Now, he will be like a shield for all those who are with you. And everything else will remain with you.”
verses.17: And Abraham prayed to God. And God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his daughters.
verses.18: For Jehovah has shut in Abimelech within his own house, because of what Sarah, the wife of Abraham, did.
